### Methods & Tools
My group works with a mix of high-fidelity traffic simulation
(e.g., SUMO, MATSIM), statistical modeling, AI, and machine learning methods. We prioritize
reproducible, open-source workflows — code for select projects is available on
[GitHub](https://github.com).
:::

::: {}
### Collaborations
I collaborate with researchers in civil engineering, computer science, and urban planning,
as well as with public-sector partners. [Get in touch](contact.qmd) about collaborating.
:::
:::
